lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Solid\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
vendor/ ships 6 packages that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 31 to 35. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.
brick/math 0.9.3, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 31 to 35
lcobucci/clock 3.5.0, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 31 to 35
psr/clock 1.0.0, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 31 to 35
psr/http-factory 1.1.0, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 31 to 35
psr/http-message 1.1, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 31 to 35
psr/log 3.0.2, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 31 to 35
5 uses of the private API of the server in 2 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
